candidate.note: the fresh materialization reproduces the frozen candidate digests byte-for-byte

retainedState.note: the used heap after confirmed natural major collections inside the measured window — REPORTED, never gated. It observes the REACHABLE V8 heap at those collections; it does not cover native or external allocations, and a flat used heap does NOT explain a rising RSS.

finalWindowRss.rule: (endRSS - startRSS_of_window) / RSS_at_window_start <= 0.02, and the least-squares slope's implied growth across the window <= 0.02 — FR-13's single pass rule (the final four hours). The endpoint growth is reported, never gated: FR-13 ratifies one band, and the endpoint term was never ratified. Not the Story 2.4 per-second rate.

reportedOnly.note: the endpoint term is reported, never gated: FR-13 ratifies one band (the slope), and this term was never ratified

fdStability.rule: every sample at or after duration/8 (one hour at the default 8) sits within +-5 of the hour-one baseline

zeroMessageLoss.rule: every acknowledged (room, seq, client_message_id) readable at the end; sequences contiguous from 1; readable set == acknowledged set; zero duplicates; payloads byte-exact

idleFootprint.note: REL-4 counter-metric: server RSS/FD/CPU with 0 Actors (start, each reconnect window, end) and the post-resume settled sample with the run's 4 Actors — reported, not optimized.
